criteria.evidence: Shares equivalent renders, retains repeatability checks and covers feasible pairs across style, source complexity and output format. Browser and seed runs target specific needs.
criteria.reason: This removes redundant executions and exercises interactions the old matrix missed.

criteria.evidence: Pins the three triggering values together with their source, format, environment and defect-specific assertion in a named mandatory row.
criteria.reason: The original reproducer survives regeneration and still checks its symptom.

criteria.evidence: Maps retired assertions to keepers, compares suites on a pinned revision, replays the defect and challenges keepers with mutations. The 4,140 reference comes from subtracting the potential repeats and permits overruns.
criteria.reason: Preservation checks govern retirement, and the required obligations determine the final count.

criteria.evidence: Groups equivalent invocations, retains distinct assertions and builds feasible pairs across style, three source classes and supported formats. Browser and seed variation uses a nightly sample.
criteria.reason: The replacement spends renders on missing interactions and retains purposeful repeats.

criteria.evidence: Keeps the original case under a stable ID with all three trigger values, the source, environment and visible-defect assertion. It requires the assertion to fail before the fix and pass afterward.
criteria.reason: Both the triggering combination and its observable failure remain explicit.

criteria.evidence: Maps obligations, shadows both suites and replays historical faults, but sets a 450-render blocking ceiling and defers overruns to a budget decision.
criteria.reason: The overrun clause protects mandatory cases. The plan still makes an unsupported case-count target a decision threshold before measuring cost or establishing how many witnesses are needed.

criteria.evidence: Shares deterministic artifacts while preserving leakage and repeatability runs. Its array covers style, complexity and format pairs, with seed and browser variation scoped to representative cases.
criteria.reason: The portfolio removes duplicate work and gives the two previously constant dimensions explicit coverage.

criteria.evidence: Keeps the named regression on every change with exact values, source, environment and original assertion, independently of array generation.
criteria.reason: The reproducer retains its own failure check even as the generated rows change.

criteria.evidence: Retains promised exhaustive enumeration, maps removals, shadows suites and compares detection on the incident and injected style and format faults. It keeps the old lane when results are inconclusive.
criteria.reason: Demonstrated fault detection and measured savings govern retirement. The model determines the row count.

criteria.evidence: Shares matching renders, preserves intentional repeats and covers feasible pairs across style, source class and format. Additional seeds and browser versions rotate on a slower lane.
criteria.reason: The reduced product directly exercises the missing interactions without multiplying every row.

criteria.evidence: Runs the exact triple, fixture, environment and symptom assertion on every change, even when a generated row contains the tuple.
criteria.reason: The incident remains a separately enforced regression.

criteria.evidence: Maps displaced assertions to keepers, checks executed tuples and registry membership, shadows both suites and restores witnesses for old-only fault detections before deletion.
criteria.reason: Retirement depends on confirmed obligations, fault detection and measured costs. The final size follows from feasible tuples and retained cases.
